cohort: Seventy-six pregnant women with severe preeclampsia (BP >=160/110 mmHg) who received IV labetalol for hypertension control.
finding: Intravenous labetalol effectively controlled blood pressure in severe preeclampsia without significantly affecting cardiotocographic findings.
mod_finding: The mean time to emergency caesarean section was 10.07 +- 2.74 minutes, reflecting clinical urgency due to foetal compromise rather than a direct effect of labetalol.
